title: [master] Adjustment Amount is not accurate in the Exch. Rate Adjmt. Ledger Entries page if an Unrealized Gain gest registered and a second adjustment turns into a Loss.
summary: Codeunit 699 now correctly calculates adjustment amounts in exchange rate adjustment ledger entries by using each row's linked detailed entry amount instead of the accumulated total.
key_points: Exchange rate adjustment ledger entries previously showed incorrect accumulated amounts for all rows
The fix applies the correct per-row detailed entry amount to the Adjustment Amount field
Affects scenarios where unrealized gains reverse into losses
Includes test cases for the corrected calculation logic
Page 186 receives decimal and caption improvements
